hunt: OFF-1 / NJ13 — Morris County Board of County Commissioners portraits
ruling: Photo rule door 2 — the portrait a government body publishes to identify its own member, with attribution and remove-on-request. morriscountynj.gov is a .gov host.
whyThePreviousHuntMissedThem: The 2026-08-15 run recorded, for six of seven, the SAME URL twice — the board INDEX page — and reported 0 candidate images. The seventh was walked at his own page and returned a portrait immediately. Each commissioner has their own page and it was already in lib/registry/body-rosters.ts as websiteUrl. The member page URLs are now DISCOVERED from the board index rather than guessed (RULING 93): this session first guessed them from names and lost three of seven to HTTP 404, because the county keeps the period after a middle initial.
standard: CLAUDE.md: a clean solo portrait or honest initials — never a wrong face, a banner, a logo, a group shot, an event candid, a screengrab or a generated likeness. Every one of the seven was READ AS AN IMAGE before this file was written; the judgment per row is below.
